game.title: Call of Duty: Black Ops 6
game.blurb: First-person shooter with a story campaign, multiplayer and Zombies, from Treyarch and Raven Software, released 2024-10-24. RAWG has no playtime yet. Genres: Action, Shooter. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). No StrategyWiki page under "Call of Duty: Black Ops 6" or "Call of Duty: Black Ops VI". callofduty.fandom.com answers the API under "Call of Duty: Black Ops 6", with 500 or more linked pages (the link list was cut off at 500), including mission pages such as "Bishop Takes Rook", "Blood Feud" and "Checkmate (level)" and Zombies pages such as "Dark Aether" and "Alistair Rhodes (Dark Aether)"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam schema calls the app "Argos" (an internal codename); the store list confirms app 4384550 as "Call of Duty®: Black Ops 6". 2 of 44 Steam achievements are hidden: "Bye-Bye, Dark Aether" is placed in Zombies because Fandom files "Dark Aether" pages with the Zombies mode, and "No Mo' Modi" sits in the later campaign chapter as a placeholder. The campaign is split by the mission order of the Steam list and its falling unlock rates. "Return of the King" (Prestige 1), "Show Off" (Mastery Badge), "Camos Are Forever" and "Betrayal" (Sleeper Agent) do not name a mode; they sit in the multiplayer chapter. Multiplayer and Zombies need online play. RAWG lists eight studios as developers; the blurb names only the first two it lists, Raven Software and Treyarch.
